title: Chapter 01: Asta — The Boy Without Mana

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: In a world where magic is everything, one boy was born with absolutely no mana. His name is Asta.

scenes.speaker: Asta
scenes.text: I don't care if I don't have a single drop of magic! My magic is NEVER GIVING UP!

scenes.speaker: Grimoire Lore
scenes.text: An ancient, tattered Grimoire adorned with a five-leaf clover rises from the darkness. A strange, encoded symbol is etched across its first page.

scenes.speaker: Asta
scenes.text: Look at this page... It's covered in strange encoded runes! Can you help me decipher what it says?

investigation.title: Anti-Magic Sword Pedestal
investigation.content: A heavy iron sword is embedded in stone. Etched into the hilt is the sequence: [A-Z, a-z, 0-9, +, /]. It appears to be encoded twice.

investigation.title: Tattered Grimoire Page
investigation.content: The page hums with anti-magic energy. Standard magic detection spells fail, but raw structural analysis reveals a Base64 standard.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: At the Grimoire Acceptance Ceremony, Yuno received the legendary Four-Leaf Clover Grimoire — the same grimoire wielded by the first Wizard King.

scenes.speaker: Yuno
scenes.text: Asta... I won't wait for you. I'm going to become the Wizard King.

scenes.speaker: Wind Spirit Sylph
scenes.text: Sylph whispers through the gale: 'The wind carries a message shifted by the luck of four leaves!'

investigation.title: Four-Leaf Emblem
investigation.content: The 4th leaf represents good luck. In cipher lore, the number four represents the shift value of the Caesar rotation.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Welcome to the Black Bulls, the most chaotic and destructive squad in the Clover Kingdom.

scenes.speaker: Captain Yami
scenes.text: Right here, right now, surpass your limits! If you die, I'll kill you!

scenes.speaker: Grimoire Lore
scenes.text: Yami slashes his dark magic katana into the stone wall, leaving a glowing Vigenère cipher.

investigation.title: Yami's Katana Markings
investigation.content: The dark magic residue forms a repeating keyword pattern: L-I-M-I-T. Use Vigenère decryption with key LIMIT.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Noelle Silva, a royal noble of House Silva, struggled for years to control her overwhelming water magic power.

scenes.speaker: Noelle Silva
scenes.text: I am royalty! My sea dragon magic will protect my squadmates!

scenes.speaker: Sea Dragon Magic
scenes.text: Her dragon spells emit a oscillating binary XOR pattern encoded in hexadecimal representation.

investigation.title: Royal Crest of House Silva
investigation.content: The emblem reads ROYAL. The byte stream requires repeated XOR operations with the key 'ROYAL'.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: The Black Bulls stand together. Each member possesses a unique magic attribute and holds a fragment of the squad seal.

scenes.speaker: Magna Swing
scenes.text: My fire magic fragment is hex encoded! Let's burn through this challenge!

scenes.speaker: Luck Voltia
scenes.text: And my lightning fragment is ROT13 shifted at top speed! Can you combine them all?

investigation.title: Squad Fragment Scroll
investigation.content: Fragment 1 (Spatial) = Base64 | Fragment 2 (Fire) = Hex | Fragment 3 (Lightning) = ROT13.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Centuries ago, the elf tribe was betrayed. Now their ancient spirits awaken using forgotten forbidden magic.

scenes.speaker: Licht
scenes.text: The Sephirot tablet contains the ancient truth of our people, written in monoalphabetic substitution.

investigation.title: Sephirot Tablet
investigation.content: Frequency mapping hints: a->q, b->w, c->e, d->r, e->t. Substitute each elven character back into standard letters.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Inside the Shadow Palace, the true mastermind reveals himself: Zagred, the Word Soul Devil.

scenes.speaker: Zagred
scenes.text: A word can become reality... My RSA spell seal N=3233 cannot be broken by mortals!

investigation.title: Devil Modulus N=3233
investigation.content: N = 3233 is small. Factoring N yields p=61 and q=53. Compute phi=(61-1)*(53-1)=3120, derive d, and decrypt c^d mod N.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Inside the 5-leaf grimoire, Asta faces his anti-magic devil Liebe in the Devil-Binding Ritual.

scenes.speaker: Liebe
scenes.text: I don't want to take over your body... I want us to fight TOGETHER as brothers against the devils!

investigation.title: Devil Binding Parchment
investigation.content: The contract is encrypted with AES-128-CBC. The 16-byte key string is 'anti_magic_liebe'.

title: Chapter 09: Dark Triad — Spade Kingdom's Shadows

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: The Dark Triad of the Spade Kingdom seeks to open the Tree of Qliphoth, unlocking the Underworld.

scenes.speaker: Dante Zogratis
scenes.text: Malice is the true nature of human emotion! Break our 3 devil hash seals if you dare!

investigation.title: Qliphoth Gate Seals
investigation.content: Dante = MD5, Vanica = SHA-1, Zenon = SHA-256. Combine the decrypted parts: OFFHA{dark_triad_ + devil_possession_ + tree_of_qliphoth}.

title: Chapter 10: Hino Country — The Flow of Ki

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Asta travels to Hino Country, the homeland of Captain Yami, to master Zetten—the ultimate Ki manipulation.

scenes.speaker: Ryudo Ryuya
scenes.text: Sense the flow of ki. Multiply your focus by 7 and shift by 13 to unleash Zetten!

investigation.title: Zetten Ki Scroll
investigation.content: Transform formula: E(c) = (c * 7) + 13. Reverse to recover character ASCII c = (E - 13) // 7.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Lucius Zogratis, wielding Time Magic and Soul Magic, seeks to remake humanity in his image.

scenes.speaker: Lucius Zogratis
scenes.text: I have seen all futures. My multi-layer temporal cipher [Base64 -> XOR(TIME) -> Hex] ensures my victory.

investigation.title: Chrono Time Hourglass
investigation.content: Reverse order of operations: Hex decode -> XOR with key 'TIME' -> Base64 decode.

title: Chapter 12: Final Grimoire — The Ultimate Anti-Magic Spell

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: The final battle has arrived. All 12 chapters lead to this moment. The Black Bulls stand united!

scenes.speaker: Asta & Black Bulls
scenes.text: WE ARE THE BLACK BULLS! Combine all squad spell keys to break the ultimate devil seal!

investigation.title: Master Grimoire Core
investigation.content: Combine spell keys from Chapters 1, 3, 7, 8, and 11: 'asta_no_magic_dark_magic_word_soul_five_leaf_time_magic'. Base64 decode ciphertext and XOR with combined key string.
